// An outward radial impulse (explosion): bodies within Radius of Center
// receive an impulse of up to Magnitude directed away from Center, falling
// off linearly to zero at Radius.
type RadialImpulse3D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Magnitude: Impulse;
    Radius: Length;
}
